criteria: All four imported formats render in Game with generated collision and LOD components
Scene and Game, including a parallel detached viewport, right mouse do not open empty context menus
Physical Project scripts expose typed per-instance fields with readonly and layout attributes
Multiple IDE buffers retain edits, Ctrl+S saves only the current script, Save All saves all
IDE scoped Find/Replace and save icon persist edited source
Add Component search and Project drag attach reusable scripts; Show in Project locates files; closed IDE reopens at center with all open tabs
Real .NET/Wasm compiles multiple classes, hydrates instance values and reports readonly fields without mutating authoring
